comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts industrial gripper hardware; PR-2127 extracts one cup from a gasket dispenser and stands it on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires driver/wrench seating and countertorque; PR-2127 requires a gentle pinch, straight compliant extraction, and stable placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades locking and repeated retained motion; PR-2127 grades exactly one undamaged cup removed, released upright, and positioned on the mat.
comparison.reason: The compliant extraction and placement ability is meaningfully different from screw-and-locknut adjustment.
